translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Minaasanne Efireema
Hewaappe guyye Asay Yooseefo, «Ne aawuu saketteedda» yaagiide odeedda. I bare laa"u attuma naanaa Minaasanne Efireema akkiidde beedda.
Aasi Yaak'ooba, «Be'a; ne na'ay Yooseefo neekko yeedda» yaageedda; Israa'eelii minettiide bare hiis'an utteedda.
Yaak'oobi Yooseefo, «Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossay Kanaane biittaan Looza giyaa sa'aan taw k'onc'c'iide, yan taana anjjeedda.
I taana, ‹Taani neena yelettissananne c'orissana; taani neena daro dere ootsana. Ha biittaa taani neeppe guyye, ne zeretsaw med'ina laata ootsaadde immana› yaageedda.
«Simmi ha"i, ne laa"u attuma naanay, taani neekko hawaa yaanaappe kase Gibs'en new yeletteeddawanttu tawantta; Efireeminne Minaase taw Roobeelanne Simoona mala.
Unttunttuppe guyye new yeletteeddawanttu newantta; unttunttu laattana biittay Efireemanne Minaasa suntsan gido.
Taani Masp'p'es'oomiyaappe simmishin, Efiraataa gakkanaw laafa ashshiyaa wode, Raaheela Kanaane biittaan hayk'k'aaddu. Taani izo Beeteleeme giyaa Efiraataa afiyaa ogiyaa doonaan moogaad» yaageedda.
Israa'eelii Yooseefo attuma naanaa laa"atuwaa be'eedda wode, «hawanttu oonee?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Yooseefo bare aawuwaa, «hawanttu S'oossay taw hawaan immeedda ta naanaa» yaageedda. Israa'eelii, «Taani unttuntta anjjana mala, unttuntta taakko haa shiishsha» yaageedda.
Israa'eelii c'imina Aa ayfii labbaneedda diraw, s'eellanaw danddayenna. Hewaa diraw Yooseefo bare attuma naanaa aakko shiishshina, Aa aawuu unttuntta idimmiide yereedda.
Israa'eele Yooseefa, «Taani ne deemuwaa be'ana gaade k'oppabeykke; shin S'oossay hekko ne naanaakka taana besseedda» yaageedda.
Yooseefo unttuntta Aa gulbbataappe dentsiide, bare deemuwaa sa'aa gatsiide goynneedda.
Yooseefo bare laa"u attuma naanaa, Efireema bare ushechcha baggan Israa'eeliyaw haddirssa baggana, Minaasa bare haddirssa baggan Israa'eeliyaw ushechcha baggana akkiide, aakko shiishsheedda.

Efireeme teefa gidooppenne, Israa'eelii bare ushechcha kushiyaa yeddiide Aa huup'iyaan wotseedda; k'ay Minaase bayira gidooppenne, Israa'eelii bare kushiyaa yediidde, bare haddirssa kushiyaa Minaase huup'iyaan wotseedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Yaak'oobi Yooseefa hawaadan yaagiide anjjeedda;

content.text: ta aawotuwaa Abrahaamanne Yisaak'a suntsay unttunttun s'eesetto.
Unttunttu sa'aa bollan c'orattino» yaagiide anjjeedda.

content: Yooseefo bare aawuu bare ushechcha kushiyaa Efireema huup'iyaan wotseeddawaa be'eedda wode dosibeenna. Hewaa diraw, Efireema huup'iyaappe dentsiide, Minaase huup'iyaan wotsanaw bare aawuwaa kushiyaa oyk'k'eedda.
Yooseefo bare aawuwaa, «Ta aawoo, hewaa gidenna; bayiray hawaatte; ne ushechcha kushiyaa hawaa bolla wotsa» yaageedda.

Shin Aa aawuu is's'iide Aa, «Taani eray; ta na'aw, taani eray; ikka wolk'k'aama dere gidana. Gidooppenne Aa teefa ishay aappe aad'd'i gitatana; Aa zeretsaykka darii wolk'k'aama kawutetsaa gidana» yaageedda.
Efireema Minaaseppe sintsayeedda.
Hewaappe guyye Israa'eelii Yooseefo, «Taani hayana hanay; shin S'oossay hinttenana gidana; k'ay I hinttenttu aawotuwaa gadiyaa hinttentta guyye zaarana.
K'ay neena ne ishatuwaanna gakkiyaa biittaappe itti saamaa darissaade new immay; hewenne taani Amooratuwaappe ta mashshaaninne ta wonddaafiyaan akkeedda biittaa» yaageedda.
